title: Practice Detail
description: Practice Detail documentation for System Admin.
overview: This guide covers practice detail workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Open the Practice tab (Primary Contact & Program Dates)
subtasks.purpose: Verify the practice's primary contact information, status, program dates, and monitoring configuration.

steps.title: Confirm Practice Tab
steps.description: Confirm the Practice tab is selected (default landing tab).

steps.title: Read Primary Contact Info
steps.description: Read the Primary Contact block: Facility, Email, Phone 1, Phone 2, Fax, Status.

steps.title: Review Program Dates
steps.description: Review the Program Dates table for each enrolled program (RPM shown with Start date, End date, Days).

steps.title: Review Monitoring Details
steps.description: Scroll to Monitoring Details to confirm whether eVitals is monitoring the patients, which vitals are tracked, and whether devices are bought or leased.

subtasks.title: Manage Practice Admins
subtasks.purpose: Review, add, or maintain Practice Admin accounts scoped to this practice.

steps.title: Open Admins Tab
steps.description: Click the Admins tab.

steps.title: Search for an Admin
steps.description: Search or filter by All Status to locate an admin.

steps.title: View, Edit, or Remove
steps.description: Click the eye icon to view details, the pencil to edit, or the trash icon to remove.

steps.title: Add Practice Admin
steps.description: Click Add Practice Admin (top-right) to create a new one.

steps.title: Audit Admin Changes
steps.description: Use Event Logs (bottom of table) to audit changes to admin records.

subtasks.title: Manage Providers
subtasks.purpose: Review or add clinicians (Providers) linked to this practice.

steps.title: Open Providers Tab
steps.description: Click the Providers tab.

steps.title: Search for a Provider
steps.description: Search or use the status filter to find a provider.

steps.title: View, Edit, or Delete
steps.description: Use the eye / pencil / trash icons for view, edit, delete.

steps.title: Add a Provider
steps.description: Click Add Providers to onboard a new clinician.

steps.title: Open Event Logs
steps.description: Open Event Logs for a change history.

subtasks.title: Manage Caregivers
subtasks.purpose: Review or add practice-level Caregivers (non-system) that support this practice's patients.

steps.title: Open Caregivers Tab
steps.description: Click the Caregivers tab.

steps.title: Locate a Caregiver
steps.description: Locate a caregiver via search or status filter.

steps.title: View, Edit, or Delete
steps.description: Use eye / pencil / trash icons for view, edit, delete.

steps.title: Add a Caregiver
steps.description: Click Add Caregiver to attach a new caregiver to the practice.

subtasks.title: Review the Patients roster & CPT billing
subtasks.purpose: Get a vitals-first view of the practice's patients with device readings, upload status, and CPT billing counters.

steps.title: Open Patients Tab
steps.description: Click the Patients tab.

steps.title: Review KPI Cards
steps.description: Read the five KPI cards; click 'click to view all' under any card to drill in.

steps.title: Review CPT Billing Counts
steps.description: Review CPT Billing counters (99453 / 99445 / 99454 and +4 more).

steps.title: Filter RPM Patients
steps.description: Search patients by name or filter by All Status; click the RPM chip to filter to RPM patients.

steps.title: Inspect, Edit, or Remove Patient
steps.description: Click the eye / pencil / trash on a patient row to inspect, edit, or remove.

steps.title: Add a Patient
steps.description: Click Add Patient to enroll a new patient. The RPM Billing Dates range in the top-right of this tab reflects the practice's active RPM contract window.

subtasks.title: Review System Caregivers assigned to the practice
subtasks.purpose: Confirm which System Caregivers are supporting patients in this practice.

steps.title: Open System Caregivers Tab
steps.description: Click the System Caregivers tab.

steps.title: Search or Filter Caregivers
steps.description: Search by name or filter by All Status.

steps.title: View, Edit, or Unassign
steps.description: Use eye / pencil / trash to view, edit, or unassign.

steps.title: Review Assignment History
steps.description: Open Event Logs to review historical assignments.

subtasks.title: Inspect the RPM program tab
subtasks.purpose: Review the RPM-specific primary contact, program window, and monitoring configuration for the practice.

steps.title: Open RPM Tab
steps.description: Click the RPM tab.

steps.title: Confirm Primary Contact
steps.description: Confirm the Primary Contact matches the Practice tab.

steps.title: Review RPM Program Dates
steps.description: Review the RPM row in Program Dates (Start date, End date, Days).

steps.title: Verify Monitoring Details
steps.description: Verify Monitoring Details: monitoring flag, vital chips (Blood Pressure, Blood Glucose, Weight), and device sourcing (Buying / Leasing).

subtasks.title: Configure Schedule & Targets — Daily Schedule
subtasks.purpose: Set the patient day (Wake-up, Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Bed Time) that anchors reading windows and reminders.

steps.title: Open Schedule & Targets Tab
steps.description: Click the Schedule & Targets tab.

steps.title: Set Daily Schedule Times
steps.description: In the Daily Schedule panel, set Wake-up Time, Breakfast Time, Lunch Time, Dinner Time, and Bed Time.

steps.title: Save or Cancel Changes
steps.description: Click Save to apply, or Cancel to discard.

steps.title: Review Schedule History
steps.description: Click Event Logs to review prior schedule changes. All fields are required (marked with *).

subtasks.title: Configure Schedule & Targets — Blood Pressure Targets
subtasks.purpose: Define reading windows and Systolic / Diastolic target ranges for Wake-up, Morning, Noon, Afternoon, and Evening.

steps.title: Scroll to BP Targets
steps.description: Scroll to the Blood Pressure Targets panel.

steps.title: Set BP Time Windows
steps.description: For each band (Wake-up, Morning, Noon, Afternoon, Evening) set the start–end time window.

steps.title: Set Systolic/Diastolic Ranges
steps.description: Enter Systolic Pressure min–max (default 100–140) and Diastolic Pressure min–max (default 60–90).

steps.title: Save & Audit BP Targets
steps.description: Click Save to persist, or Cancel to discard. Use Event Logs to audit prior values. Time windows should not overlap across bands. Ranges above/below the targets are flagged as abnormal in the Patients tab.

subtasks.title: Configure Schedule & Targets — Blood Glucose Targets
subtasks.purpose: Define glucose target ranges and mealtime windows used to classify pre/post-meal glucose readings.

steps.title: Scroll to Glucose Targets
steps.description: Scroll to the Blood Glucose Targets panel.

steps.title: Set Glucose Target Ranges
steps.description: Set Wake-up Target Range, Before-Meal Target Range, After-Meal Target Range, Bedtime Target Range, and Midnight Target Range (each min–max).

steps.title: Set Wake-Up Time
steps.description: Set Wake-up Time (start–end).

steps.title: Set Meal Time Windows
steps.description: Set Before-Breakfast, After-Breakfast, Before-Lunch, After-Lunch, Before-Dinner, After-Dinner time windows.

steps.title: Set Bedtime & Midnight Windows
steps.description: Set Bedtime and Midnight windows.

steps.title: Save & Review Glucose History
steps.description: Click Save (or Cancel). Use Event Logs to review history. Meal windows should not overlap; adjacent windows chain end→start (e.g., After-Breakfast end = Before-Lunch start).

subtasks.title: Configure Schedule & Targets — Weight Targets
subtasks.purpose: Set the recommended weight, body-fat, BMI and daily time-window targets used to classify each patient’s weight readings.

steps.title: Open the practice and select the Schedule & Targets tab; scroll to the Weight Targets card.
steps.description: Open the practice and select the Schedule & Targets tab; scroll to the Weight Targets card. Confirm the Recommended Weight Range and Recommended Body Fat Range shown as guidance (read-only). Enter the lower and upper bounds for Weight Target Range (lb) and Body Fat Target Range (%). Set the BMI thresholds for Normal, Overweight and Obese; the Underweight cell is derived automatically. Adjust the Morning, Afternoon and Evening time windows if the practice uses non-default weigh-in slots. Click Save to persist the targets, or Cancel to discard changes. Use Event Logs to review who last edited these values. Notes All numeric inputs accept one decimal place; the UI validates that lower bound < upper bound. Evening window may span midnight (end time < start time) — the system treats it as an overnight interval. Changes take effect on the next weight reading uploaded from the paired scale.

subtasks.title: Bulk import patients (Import Patients tab)
subtasks.purpose: Add multiple patients to a practice in a single upload by supplying a CSV / Excel file mapped to a chosen Provider and Caregiver.

steps.title: Open the practice and click the Import Patients tab in the practice sub-navigation.
steps.description: Open the practice and click the Import Patients tab in the practice sub-navigation. In the Add Bulk Patients card, choose a Provider from the dropdown. Choose a Caregiver from the second dropdown. Click Upload CSV/Excel and select the prepared file; the chosen filename replaces the "No file chosen" placeholder. Click Import Patients to start processing. A confirmation toast reports how many rows succeeded and how many failed. If failures are reported, download the error file, correct the flagged rows and re-upload only the corrected subset. Click Cancel to abandon the import before submission. Notes Provider and Caregiver selections apply to every row in the file — split the file if patients need different assignments. The importer is idempotent by MRN; a duplicate MRN row is skipped rather than creating a second patient. Program-enrolment columns in the file (CCM/RPM start dates) must fall within the practice’s active billing cycle or the row is rejected. Task 6.3 — Caregivers
